item.title: Winter storm watches issued for all counties
item.description: Saturday will start dry, but precipitation chances increase through the day, with most of the activity expected Saturday evening into the overnight hours. Snow main precipitation form. The Pee Dee region is expected to stay cold enough for all snow, while coastal areas will likely begin with rain before transitioning to snow.
